## Assemble the full likelihood and check the spatial footprint

```{r joint-likelihood-data}
model_columns <- c("dataset", "site", "taxon", "class", "Type", "dir", "n",
                   "transect_area_m2", "region", "source", "latitude", "longitude",
                   "ns_distance_from_channel_m")
joint_counts <- bind_rows(select(original_joint_counts, all_of(model_columns)),
                          select(regional_adults, all_of(model_columns)),
                          select(regional_juveniles, all_of(model_columns)))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(joint_counts[c("dataset", "site", "taxon", "class")]),
          all(joint_counts$n >= 0 & joint_counts$n == round(joint_counts$n)),
          all(joint_counts$transect_area_m2 > 0))
write_csv(joint_counts, output_file("joint_model_inputs.csv"))
joint_survey_summary <- joint_counts %>% group_by(region, dataset, source, class, Type) %>%
  summarize(sites = n_distinct(site), rows = n(), colonies = sum(n), .groups = "drop")
write_csv(joint_survey_summary, output_file("joint_survey_summary.csv"))
show_table(joint_survey_summary)

# The geometric outlines differ, but all modeled sites must classify identically.
zone_union <- st_union(st_transform(st_make_valid(all_zones_sf), 32617))
geographic_sites <- distinct(joint_counts, dataset, site, region, latitude, longitude)
geographic_points <- st_as_sf(geographic_sites, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
                              crs = 4326, remove = FALSE) %>% st_transform(32617)
geographic_sites$inside_original_polygon_union <- lengths(st_covered_by(geographic_points, zone_union)) > 0
geographic_sites$inside_ns_band <- geographic_sites$region == "PEV"
write_csv(geographic_sites, output_file("spatial_classification_crosscheck.csv"))
stopifnot(all(geographic_sites$inside_original_polygon_union == geographic_sites$inside_ns_band))
pev_raw_counts <- joint_counts %>% filter(region == "PEV")

# Freeze the original source-coverage grid for manuscript source averaging.
# These are weights/grids, not reuse of the old fitted posterior.
prediction_reference <- dfftaxon
```

## Specify the joint model in brms

This candidate keeps the same observed likelihood rows and scientific targets
as the previous joint pilot. The following choices are explicit:

| Component | brms candidate |
|:--|:--|
| Observations | Identical counts, effort, site/source, taxon/class/habitat and regional assignments |
| Family and offset | Zero-inflated negative binomial; log searched area |
| Baseline structure | Original taxon:class * Type for counts, zi and shape |
| Baseline coefficient priors | Selected explicitly by prior_version; count priors retained in both versions |
| Intercept centering | Ordinary combined-data brms centering, including regional count columns |
| Regional count differences | One normal(0, 1.5) coefficient on the log NB mean per taxon/class/habitat cell |
| Regional zi/shape differences | Optional independent cell slopes; disabled in the shared-distribution pilot |
| Shared survey effects | Original survey/habitat and survey/taxon/class grouping and priors |
| Direction | Taxon/class/habitat/direction groups; separate exponential(4) SDs by region |
| Manuscript predictions | Explicit PEV; survey effects retained and direction effects zero |
| Regional comparisons | Explicit paired PEV and Broward–Miami predictions for drm24; equal weights for NRC, IR, MR and OR |

The combined centering changes the intercept's meaning and the induced prior
covariance, particularly its relationship with regional count coefficients.
This is an intentional prior parameterization choice, not an assertion that
all cell-density priors are identical to the previous fit. The conditional
prior predictive checks expose the resulting density scales. The original
priors put nonzero means on zi/shape coefficients; the revised version puts
these coefficients around zero and explicitly calibrates the log-shape intercept.


`regional` is 0 for PEV and 1 for Broward–Miami. The count term
`regional:cell` gives every taxon × class × habitat cell its own regional
coefficient on the log NB mean. When `regional_distributional_effects` is true,
the zero-inflation and shape terms use a regional random slope for each cell,
with separate half-normal(0, 0.75) SD priors. When it is false, both parameters
are shared across regions within each taxon/class/habitat cell; the regional
count coefficients remain. Shared source effects retain
the original structure, and `by = region` permits different direction SDs.

```{r joint-model-data}
taxon_class_grid <- original_survey_counts %>% distinct(taxon, class) %>%
  arrange(taxon, class) %>% mutate(tc_id = row_number())
cell_grid <- crossing(taxon_class_grid, Type = type_levels) %>%
  arrange(tc_id, match(Type, type_levels)) %>%
  mutate(cell_id = row_number(), habitat_id = match(Type, type_levels))
joint_counts <- joint_counts %>%
  left_join(select(cell_grid, taxon, class, Type, cell_id, tc_id),
            by = c("taxon", "class", "Type"))
for (variable in c("taxon", "class", "Type")) {
  levels_used <- if (is.factor(prediction_reference[[variable]])) {
    levels(prediction_reference[[variable]])
  } else sort(unique(prediction_reference[[variable]]))
  joint_counts[[variable]] <- factor(joint_counts[[variable]], levels = levels_used)
}
joint_counts <- joint_counts %>%
  mutate(region = factor(region, levels = c("PEV", "Broward-Miami")),
         dataset = factor(dataset, levels = dataset_levels),
         regional = as.integer(region == "Broward-Miami"),
         cell = factor(cell_id, levels = cell_grid$cell_id,
                       labels = paste(cell_grid$taxon, cell_grid$class, cell_grid$Type, sep = "__")),
         direction_group = interaction(region, taxon, class, Type, dir, drop = TRUE))
stopifnot(!anyNA(joint_counts[c("n", "regional", "cell", "direction_group", "transect_area_m2")]),
          all(joint_counts$transect_area_m2 > 0))
model_data <- as.data.frame(joint_counts)
prepared <- list(counts = joint_counts, grid = cell_grid, tc = taxon_class_grid,
                 datasets = dataset_levels, original_data = prediction_reference,
                 data = list(K = nrow(cell_grid), target_dataset = match("drm24", dataset_levels)))
saveRDS(prepared, processed_file("prepared_joint_inputs.rds"))
show_table(data.frame(original_rows = nrow(original_survey_counts),
                     added_adult_rows = nrow(regional_adults), added_juvenile_rows = nrow(regional_juveniles),
                     model_rows = nrow(joint_counts), taxon_class_habitat_cells = nrow(cell_grid)))
```

```{r joint-model-formula}
joint_formula <- bf(
  n ~ taxon:class * Type + regional:cell +
    (1 + Type | dataset) +
    (1 | dataset:taxon:class) +
    (1 | gr(direction_group, by = region)) +
    offset(log(transect_area_m2)),
  zi ~ taxon:class * Type,
  shape ~ taxon:class * Type
)
# Retain the earlier flexible pilot as an explicitly selectable benchmark.
if (params$regional_distributional_effects) {
  joint_formula <- bf(
    n ~ taxon:class * Type + regional:cell +
      (1 + Type | dataset) +
      (1 | dataset:taxon:class) +
      (1 | gr(direction_group, by = region)) +
      offset(log(transect_area_m2)),
    zi ~ taxon:class * Type + (0 + regional | cell),
    shape ~ taxon:class * Type + (0 + regional | cell)
  )
}
joint_family <- zero_inflated_negbinomial()
```

## Generate data-informed priors

This section follows the four descriptive calculations in
the archived `coral_analysis_original.Rmd`, now using all observations entering
the joint likelihood.
The original observations are summarized alongside the joint data to show what
changed when the regional surveys were added. These calculations inform broad,
rounded prior choices; they do not automatically replace the chosen constants
each time the document is rendered. The same observations inform calibration
and the likelihood, so these are data-informed regularization choices, not
independent external prior evidence or estimates of hyperparameter uncertainty.

### Count intercept and taxon/class/habitat effects

```{r generate-count-priors}
# Repeat the original positive-density summaries on the joint observations.
# Area is the actual search effort for that taxon and size class at each site.
df_pos <- model_data %>%
  filter(n > 0) %>%
  mutate(density = n / transect_area_m2,
         log_density = log(density))
summary(df_pos$log_density)
sd(df_pos$log_density)

group_effects <- df_pos %>%
  group_by(taxon, class, Type) %>%
  summarize(mean_log_density = mean(log_density), .groups = "drop")
sd(group_effects$mean_log_density)

# Compare with the reconstructed original PEV survey cohort, before adding DRM.
original_positive <- original_survey_counts %>%
  filter(n > 0) %>%
  mutate(log_density = log(n / transect_area_m2))
original_group_effects <- original_positive %>%
  group_by(taxon, class, Type) %>%
  summarize(mean_log_density = mean(log_density), .groups = "drop")
count_prior_calibration <- data.frame(
  observations = c("Original surveys", "Joint observations"),
  rows = c(nrow(original_survey_counts), nrow(model_data)),
  mean_positive_log_density = c(mean(original_positive$log_density), mean(df_pos$log_density)),
  sd_positive_log_density = c(sd(original_positive$log_density), sd(df_pos$log_density)),
  sd_positive_cell_means = c(sd(original_group_effects$mean_log_density),
                            sd(group_effects$mean_log_density))
)
write_csv(count_prior_calibration, output_file("prior_calibration_counts.csv"))
show_table(count_prior_calibration, digits = 3)

# PRIOR CHOICES (declared explicitly in joint_priors below):
# Count Intercept: normal(-2.8, 1.8), retained from the original analysis.
# Count b effects: normal(0, 2), retained as a broad, symmetric effect prior.
```

The joint positive log-density mean is about −2.73 with SD 1.72, close to the
original −2.78 and 1.79. This supports retaining `normal(-2.8, 1.8)` as a rough
count-intercept anchor. However, it describes positive observations; the
negative-binomial mean also governs NB-generated zeros. The fitted intercept
uses the combined-data predictor centering in brms, so this empirical location
is a heuristic, not a direct estimate of that intercept or of PEV density.

Positive cell means have SD about 1.30 versus 1.34 originally. Their spread is
not the SD of an individual coded coefficient, and all-zero cells are omitted
from this positive-only calculation. We therefore retain `normal(0, 2)` for
the count coefficients rather than tightening it mechanically to 1.30.
Expected density also includes zero inflation; the prior predictive checks
below evaluate the priors induced on that actual prediction target.

### Zero inflation

```{r generate-zero-inflation-priors}
# Repeat the original observed-zero calculation, including all-zero cells.
# Clipping only makes this descriptive logit finite; it does not alter data.
zi_est <- model_data %>%
  group_by(taxon, class, Type) %>%
  summarize(p_zero = mean(n == 0), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(logit_p_zero = qlogis(pmin(pmax(p_zero, 1e-4), 1 - 1e-4)))
mean(zi_est$logit_p_zero)
sd(zi_est$logit_p_zero)

# Relate variation across cells to the scale of the coded coefficients.
# Independent coefficient SD=1 induces this predictor-spread multiplier across
# equally weighted taxon/class/habitat cells. Intercept uncertainty is excluded.
prior_cell_grid <- cell_grid
for (variable in c("taxon", "class", "Type")) {
  prior_cell_grid[[variable]] <- factor(prior_cell_grid[[variable]],
                                       levels = levels(model_data[[variable]]))
}
prior_cell_design <- model.matrix(~ taxon:class * Type, data = prior_cell_grid)
prior_design_multiplier <- sqrt(sum(apply(prior_cell_design[, -1, drop = FALSE], 2, var)))
zero_prior_calibration <- data.frame(
  mean_observed_zero_logit = mean(zi_est$logit_p_zero),
  sd_observed_zero_logit = sd(zi_est$logit_p_zero),
  design_spread_multiplier = prior_design_multiplier,
  descriptive_coefficient_sd = sd(zi_est$logit_p_zero) / prior_design_multiplier
)
write_csv(zero_prior_calibration, output_file("prior_calibration_zero_inflation.csv"))
show_table(zero_prior_calibration, digits = 3)

# PRIOR CHOICES:
# zi Intercept: logistic(0, 1), retaining the original brms default explicitly.
# zi b effects: normal(0, 2), symmetric contributions to the logit predictor.
```

The observed zero-logit SD is about 2.79. With this design, coefficient SD 1
produces cell-to-cell predictor spread about 1.51; 2.79 / 1.51 is about 1.84.
This provides a rough scale check for the rounded `normal(0, 2)` coefficient
prior. It is not a fit of the zero-inflation model. In a ZINB distribution,

\[
\Pr(Y=0)=zi+(1-zi)\left(\frac{\phi}{\phi+\mu}\right)^\phi,
\]

so the observed fraction of zeros is not the structural zero-inflation
probability `zi`. We do not center every coefficient on the observed zero-logit
mean. Centering coefficients at zero avoids imposing a preferred direction
on the coded effects. The separate `logistic(0, 1)` intercept prior is broad:
its inverse-logit transformation is uniform on (0, 1), before adding effects.

### Negative-binomial shape

```{r generate-shape-priors}
# Repeat the original pseudo-count variance-to-mean recipe for comparability.
# More than five positive rows are required for this descriptive calculation.
vmr_summary <- model_data %>%
  mutate(dens = n / transect_area_m2) %>%
  group_by(taxon, class, Type) %>%
  filter(sum(dens > 0) > 5) %>%
  mutate(dens_min = min(dens[dens > 0]),
         pseudo_n = round(dens / dens_min)) %>%
  summarize(mean_n = mean(pseudo_n), var_n = var(pseudo_n), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(vmr = var_n / mean_n,
         phi_est = ifelse(vmr > 1, mean_n / (vmr - 1), NA_real_),
         log_phi = log(phi_est))
summary(vmr_summary$log_phi)
sd(vmr_summary$log_phi, na.rm = TRUE)
shape_prior_calibration <- data.frame(
  mean_pseudo_log_shape = mean(vmr_summary$log_phi, na.rm = TRUE),
  sd_pseudo_log_shape = sd(vmr_summary$log_phi, na.rm = TRUE),
  design_spread_multiplier = prior_design_multiplier,
  descriptive_coefficient_sd = sd(vmr_summary$log_phi, na.rm = TRUE) / prior_design_multiplier
)
write_csv(vmr_summary, output_file("prior_calibration_pseudo_dispersion_cells.csv"))
write_csv(shape_prior_calibration, output_file("prior_calibration_shape.csv"))
show_table(shape_prior_calibration, digits = 3)

# PRIOR CHOICES (shape has a log link):
# Centered log-shape Intercept: normal(-1, 1.5).
# Log-shape b effects: normal(0, 1).
```

The joint pseudo-log-shape mean is about −0.94, close to the original −0.89.
We use its rounded location −1 as a rough anchor for the centered log-shape
intercept, with broad SD 1.5. The pseudo-log-shape SD is about 1.29; dividing
by the design multiplier gives about 0.85, supporting coefficient SD 1 as a
rounded, broad choice. Coefficients are centered at zero because their
contributions are distinct from the overall log-shape location.

These proxies mix search effort, sources, years, directions and zero inflation.
They are not direct estimates of conditional ZINB shape, and the pseudo-count
conversion itself changes the count scale. The pseudo-counts are used only
here to repeat the original calibration recipe; the fitted likelihood always
uses the actual integer colony counts and their searched-area offsets.

### Regional effects and random-effect regularization

```{r generate-regional-prior-check}
# Check that the regional count prior is broad relative to well-observed raw
# adult comparisons. These are descriptive rates, not fitted regional effects.
regional_prior_rates <- model_data %>%
  filter(dataset == "drm24", class == ">4cm") %>%
  group_by(region, taxon, Type) %>%
  summarize(sites = n_distinct(site), positives = sum(n > 0),
            colonies = sum(n), area = sum(transect_area_m2), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(density = colonies / area)
regional_prior_pairs <- inner_join(
  filter(regional_prior_rates, region == "PEV"),
  filter(regional_prior_rates, region == "Broward-Miami"),
  by = c("taxon", "Type"), suffix = c("_PEV", "_BM")) %>%
  filter(sites_PEV >= 5, sites_BM >= 5, positives_PEV >= 3, positives_BM >= 3) %>%
  mutate(raw_ratio_BM_to_PEV = density_BM / density_PEV)
regional_prior_calibration <- regional_prior_pairs %>%
  summarize(cells = n(), smallest_raw_ratio = min(raw_ratio_BM_to_PEV),
            largest_raw_ratio = max(raw_ratio_BM_to_PEV)) %>%
  mutate(prior_ratio_lower_95 = exp(qnorm(.025, 0, 1.5)),
         prior_ratio_upper_95 = exp(qnorm(.975, 0, 1.5)))
write_csv(regional_prior_pairs, output_file("prior_calibration_regional_pairs.csv"))
write_csv(regional_prior_calibration, output_file("prior_calibration_regional.csv"))
show_table(regional_prior_calibration, digits = 3)

# PRIOR CHOICES:
# Regional count b effects: normal(0, 1.5), symmetric on the log NB-mean scale.
# Random-effect SDs: exponential(4), retaining original regularization.
# Dataset-effect correlations: lkj(1), explicitly retaining the brms default.
```

The well-observed adult cells have raw regional ratios about 0.37–3.45.
The regional coefficient prior `normal(0, 1.5)` permits NB-mean ratios about
1/19–19 in its central 95% interval. This is a broad symmetric regularization
choice, not an estimate centered on the observed difference. The raw check
omits sparse cells and does not adjust direction or standardize habitats.

The original `exponential(4)` SD prior has mean 0.25 and 95th percentile about
0.75 on the random-effect coefficient scale. It regularizes source and
direction variation, including the separate regional direction SDs. It was a
regularization choice rather than an output of the four empirical summaries.
`lkj(1)` is uniform over the dataset-effect correlation matrices. In the
selected model, zi and shape are shared across regions within a
taxon/class/habitat cell, so there are no regional zi/shape departure SD priors.

### Declare the selected priors

Count priors stay the same in both versions: `normal(-2.8, 1.8)` for the
centered intercept, `normal(0, 2)` for baseline coefficients and
`normal(0, 1.5)` for regional count coefficients. The revised version follows
the prior review: zi coefficients `normal(0, 2)`, log-shape coefficients
`normal(0, 1)` and log-shape intercept `normal(-1, 1.5)`. The zi intercept
retains `logistic(0, 1)`. Original priors remain selectable for cached benchmarks.
No fitted posterior is used as a prior and no density draws are discarded.

```{r joint-model-priors}
joint_priors <- c(
  prior(normal(-2.8, 1.8), class = "Intercept"),
  prior(normal(0, 2), class = "b"),
  prior(normal(0, 2), class = "b", dpar = "zi"),
  prior(logistic(0, 1), class = "Intercept", dpar = "zi"),
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b", dpar = "shape"),
  prior(normal(-1, 1.5), class = "Intercept", dpar = "shape"),
  prior(exponential(4), class = "sd"),
  prior(lkj(1), class = "cor")
)
if (params$prior_version == "original") {
  joint_priors <- c(
    prior(normal(-2.8, 1.8), class = "Intercept"),
    prior(normal(0, 2), class = "b"),
    prior(normal(1.5, 2.5), class = "b", dpar = "zi"),
    prior(logistic(0, 1), class = "Intercept", dpar = "zi"),
    prior(normal(-0.9, 1), class = "b", dpar = "shape"),
    prior(student_t(3, 0, 2.5), class = "Intercept", dpar = "shape"),
    prior(exponential(4), class = "sd"),
    prior(lkj(1), class = "cor")
  )
}
if (params$regional_distributional_effects) {
  joint_priors <- c(joint_priors,
    prior(normal(0, 0.75), class = "sd", group = "cell", dpar = "zi"),
    prior(normal(0, 0.75), class = "sd", group = "cell", dpar = "shape"))
}
available_priors <- get_prior(joint_formula, data = model_data, family = joint_family)
regional_coefficients <- available_priors$coef[
  available_priors$class == "b" & available_priors$dpar == "" &
    grepl("^regional:cell", available_priors$coef)
]
stopifnot(length(regional_coefficients) == nrow(cell_grid))
for (coefficient in regional_coefficients) {
  joint_priors <- c(joint_priors,
                    set_prior("normal(0, 1.5)", class = "b", coef = coefficient))
}
write_csv(as.data.frame(joint_priors), output_file("model_priors.csv"))
writeLines(capture.output(joint_formula), output_file("model_formula.txt"))
```

## Prior predictive checks

These checks sample directly from the specified priors before using the counts
in the likelihood. They describe densities and replicated counts conditional
on zero source and direction effects. Regional zero-inflation/shape slopes
are included only when the fitted model contains them. These are targeted checks of the density priors, rather than full
simulations of survey-to-survey variation. Intercept centering is calculated from
the combined design matrix exactly as in brms. No draws are removed by density.

```{r prior-predictive-checks}
set.seed(20261028)
prior_draw_count <- 4000L
prior_grid <- bind_rows(mutate(cell_grid, region = "PEV"),
                         mutate(cell_grid, region = "Broward-Miami")) %>%
  mutate(regional = as.integer(region == "Broward-Miami"),
         cell = factor(cell_id, levels = cell_grid$cell_id, labels = levels(model_data$cell)))
for (v in c("taxon", "class", "Type")) {
  prior_grid[[v]] <- factor(prior_grid[[v]], levels = levels(model_data[[v]]))
}
count_fixed <- ~ taxon:class * Type + regional:cell
baseline_fixed <- ~ taxon:class * Type
# brms reorders interaction columns internally. Match terms by their factors,
# then verify the entire training matrix before simulating from the priors.
canonical_term <- function(x) vapply(strsplit(gsub("[ ()]", "", x), ":", fixed = TRUE),
                                     function(z) paste(sort(z), collapse = ":"), character(1))
prior_standata <- make_standata(joint_formula, data = model_data,
                                family = joint_family, prior = joint_priors)
align_design <- function(formula, target) {
  train <- model.matrix(formula, model_data)
  fresh <- model.matrix(formula, prior_grid)
  j <- match(canonical_term(colnames(target)), canonical_term(colnames(train)))
  stopifnot(!anyNA(j), identical(dim(train[, j]), dim(target)),
            isTRUE(all.equal(unname(train[, j]), unname(target), check.attributes = FALSE)))
  sweep(fresh[, j[-1], drop = FALSE], 2, colMeans(target[, -1, drop = FALSE]), "-")
}
X_count_new <- align_design(count_fixed, prior_standata$X)
X_base_new <- align_design(baseline_fixed, prior_standata$X_zi)
stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(unname(prior_standata$X_zi),
                            unname(prior_standata$X_shape), check.attributes = FALSE)))
S <- prior_draw_count
beta_count <- matrix(rnorm(S * ncol(X_count_new), 0, 2), S)
regional_columns <- grepl("^regional:cell", colnames(X_count_new))
beta_count[, regional_columns] <- rnorm(S * sum(regional_columns), 0, 1.5)
beta_zi <- if (params$prior_version == "revised") {
  matrix(rnorm(S * ncol(X_base_new), 0, 2), S)
} else matrix(rnorm(S * ncol(X_base_new), 1.5, 2.5), S)
beta_shape <- if (params$prior_version == "revised") {
  matrix(rnorm(S * ncol(X_base_new), 0, 1), S)
} else matrix(rnorm(S * ncol(X_base_new), -0.9, 1), S)
prior_log_mu <- sweep(beta_count %*% t(X_count_new), 1, rnorm(S, -2.8, 1.8), "+")
prior_zi_logit <- sweep(beta_zi %*% t(X_base_new), 1, qlogis(runif(S)), "+")
shape_intercept_draws <- if (params$prior_version == "revised") {
  rnorm(S, -1, 1.5)
} else 2.5 * rt(S, df = 3)
prior_log_shape <- sweep(beta_shape %*% t(X_base_new), 1, shape_intercept_draws, "+")
K <- nrow(cell_grid)
if (params$regional_distributional_effects) {
  prior_zi_logit[, K + seq_len(K)] <- prior_zi_logit[, K + seq_len(K)] +
    sweep(matrix(rnorm(S * K), S), 1, abs(rnorm(S, 0, 0.75)), "*")
  prior_log_shape[, K + seq_len(K)] <- prior_log_shape[, K + seq_len(K)] +
    sweep(matrix(rnorm(S * K), S), 1, abs(rnorm(S, 0, 0.75)), "*")
} else {
  stopifnot(identical(unname(prior_zi_logit[, seq_len(K)]),
                      unname(prior_zi_logit[, K + seq_len(K)])),
            identical(unname(prior_log_shape[, seq_len(K)]),
                      unname(prior_log_shape[, K + seq_len(K)])))
}
prior_log_density <- prior_log_mu + plogis(-prior_zi_logit, log.p = TRUE)
prior_area <- joint_counts %>% filter(dataset == "drm24") %>%
  group_by(taxon, class) %>% summarize(area = median(transect_area_m2), .groups = "drop")
prior_grid <- left_join(prior_grid, prior_area, by = c("taxon", "class"))
prior_mu_counts <- exp(sweep(prior_log_mu, 2, log(prior_grid$area), "+"))
prior_counts <- matrix(rnbinom(length(prior_mu_counts), mu = prior_mu_counts,
                               size = exp(prior_log_shape)), S)
prior_counts[matrix(runif(length(prior_counts)), S) < plogis(prior_zi_logit)] <- 0
prior_summary <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(prior_grid)), function(i) {
  z <- prior_log_density[, i]
  y <- prior_counts[, i]
  q <- exp(quantile(z, c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975)))
  cbind(prior_grid[i, ], data.frame(lower = q[1], median = q[2], upper = q[3],
    probability_density_gt_1 = mean(z > 0),
    probability_density_gt_10 = mean(z > log(10)),
    probability_density_gt_100 = mean(z > log(100)),
    replicated_zero_fraction = mean(y == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    replicated_count_975 = unname(quantile(y, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)),
    numerical_failure_fraction = mean(!is.finite(y))))
})) %>% mutate(regional_full_survey_support = region == "PEV" | class == ">4cm" |
                 taxon %in% c("MCAV", "MEAN", "MUSS", "FAVI"))
write_csv(prior_summary, output_file("prior_predictive_conditional_summary.csv"))
saveRDS(list(grid = prior_grid, log_density = prior_log_density, counts = prior_counts),
        processed_file("prior_predictive_conditional_draws.rds"))
prior_plot <- prior_summary %>% filter(class == ">4cm", taxon %in% c("ACER", "AGAR", "MCAV", "ORBI", "SIDE")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(taxon, median, color = region)) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), position = position_dodge(width = 0.4)) +
  scale_y_log10() + facet_wrap(~Type, nrow = 1) + theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Prior density: median and 95% interval (colonies/m²)",
       title = "Conditional prior predictive densities",
       subtitle = if (params$regional_distributional_effects) {
         "Source and direction effects zero; regional distributional departures retained"
       } else "Source and direction effects zero; zi and shape shared across regions")
ggsave(output_file("prior_predictive_densities.png"), prior_plot, width = 13, height = 5, dpi = 220, bg = "white")
show_table(prior_summary %>% filter(taxon == "ACER", class == ">4cm"), digits = 4)
knitr::include_graphics(output_file("prior_predictive_densities.png"))
rm(beta_count, beta_zi, beta_shape, prior_log_mu, prior_zi_logit,
   prior_log_shape, prior_log_density, prior_counts, prior_mu_counts, prior_standata)
```

## Fit and save the model

`allow_new_fit` defaults to false to protect the saved pilot. Enable it only
when intentionally fitting a new model or changing the sampling settings.

Each distinct model, data and sampling specification receives a separate
cache folder. The complete `brmsfit` is saved immediately after fitting and
reused on subsequent renders. Compilation details below only accommodate the
local macOS toolchain; they do not alter the statistical model.

<details>
<summary>Saved-fit identification and local compiler compatibility</summary>

```{r fit-settings}
fit_settings <- list(
  chains = as.integer(params$chains), warmup = as.integer(params$warmup),
  sampling = as.integer(params$sampling), threads = as.integer(params$threads_per_chain),
  adapt_delta = params$adapt_delta, max_treedepth = as.integer(params$max_treedepth),
  seed = as.integer(params$seed)
)
# Simple R names used in the fitting call below.
chains <- fit_settings$chains
warmup <- fit_settings$warmup
sampling <- fit_settings$sampling
threads_per_chain <- fit_settings$threads
adapt_delta <- fit_settings$adapt_delta
max_treedepth <- fit_settings$max_treedepth
seed <- fit_settings$seed
stan_code <- make_stancode(joint_formula, data = model_data, family = joint_family,
                           prior = joint_priors, threads = threading(fit_settings$threads))
signature_columns <- c("n", "taxon", "class", "Type", "region", "regional", "cell",
                       "dataset", "dir", "direction_group", "transect_area_m2")
fit_signature <- list(data = model_data[signature_columns],
                      priors = as.data.frame(joint_priors), settings = fit_settings,
                      stan = stan_code, brms_version = as.character(packageVersion("brms")))
fit_hash <- digest::digest(fit_signature, algo = "md5")
fit_directory <- output_file("models", fit_hash)
dir.create(fit_directory, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
fit_file <- file.path(fit_directory, "brms_fit.rds")
cmdstan_directory <- file.path(fit_directory, "cmdstan")
dir.create(cmdstan_directory, showWarnings = FALSE)
saveRDS(fit_signature, file.path(fit_directory, "signature.rds"))
writeLines(stan_code, file.path(fit_directory, "brms_generated_model.stan"))
fit_status <- function(status) {
  jsonlite::write_json(list(status = status, fit = fit_file, hash = fit_hash,
                            chain_output_directory = cmdstan_directory, initialization = 0,
                            settings = fit_settings, prior_version = params$prior_version,
                            regional_distributional_effects = params$regional_distributional_effects,
                            updated = as.character(Sys.time())),
                       output_file("run_status.json"), auto_unbox = TRUE, pretty = TRUE)
}
```

```{r compiler-functions}
compatible_cpp_options <- function() {
    if (!identical(Sys.info()[["sysname"]], "Darwin")) 
        return(list())
    probe_dir <- tempfile("regional-cxx-")
    dir.create(probe_dir)
    on.exit(unlink(probe_dir, recursive = TRUE), add = TRUE)
    source_file <- file.path(probe_dir, "check.cpp")
    executable <- file.path(probe_dir, "check")
    writeLines(c("#include <iostream>", "int main() { std::cout << \"C++ link OK\\n\"; }"), source_file)
    probe <- function(flags = character()) suppressWarnings(system2("clang++", c("-std=c++17", flags, 
        shQuote(source_file), "-o", shQuote(executable)), stdout = TRUE, stderr = TRUE))
    default_check <- probe()
    if (is.null(attr(default_check, "status"))) 
        return(list())
    if (!any(grepl("unknown architecture", default_check, fixed = TRUE)) || !any(grepl("arm64e.x1", 
        default_check, fixed = TRUE))) 
        stop(paste(default_check, collapse = "\n"), call. = FALSE)
    sdk <- suppressWarnings(system2("xcrun", c("--sdk", "macosx26.5", "--show-sdk-path"), stdout = TRUE, 
        stderr = TRUE))
    if (!is.null(attr(sdk, "status")) || length(sdk) != 1L || !dir.exists(sdk)) 
        stop("The compatible macOS 26.5 SDK is unavailable.", call. = FALSE)
    sdk_flags <- c("-isysroot", shQuote(normalizePath(sdk, mustWork = TRUE)))
    fallback_check <- probe(sdk_flags)
    if (!is.null(attr(fallback_check, "status"))) 
        stop(paste(fallback_check, collapse = "\n"), call. = FALSE)
    message("Using compatible macOS SDK for this model: ", sdk)
    list(CXX = paste(c("clang++", sdk_flags), collapse = " "))
}

# Keep Stan's iteration messages visible while knitr captures the fit chunk.
# This changes logging only; the expression returns the ordinary brms fit.
with_progress_log <- function(path, expression) {
  progress_connection <- file(path, open = "wt")
  sink(progress_connection, split = TRUE)
  on.exit({ sink(); close(progress_connection) }, add = TRUE)
  force(expression)
}

```

</details>

```{r fit-joint-model}
if (file.exists(fit_file)) {
  joint_fit <- readRDS(fit_file)
  fit_status("posterior_reused")
} else {
  if (!isTRUE(params$allow_new_fit)) stop("No matching cache; enable allow_new_fit to run the model.")
  fit_status("compiling_and_sampling")
  compiler_options <- compatible_cpp_options()
  joint_fit <- with_progress_log(file.path(fit_directory, "fit_progress.log"), brm(
    formula = joint_formula,
    data = model_data,
    family = zero_inflated_negbinomial(),
    prior = joint_priors,
    chains = chains, cores = chains,
    iter = warmup + sampling, warmup = warmup,
    threads = threading(threads_per_chain),
    backend = "cmdstanr",
    control = list(adapt_delta = adapt_delta, max_treedepth = max_treedepth),
    seed = seed,
    init = 0,
    output_dir = cmdstan_directory,
    stan_model_args = list(cpp_options = compiler_options),
    refresh = 25,
    file = sub("[.]rds$", "", fit_file), file_refit = "never",
    save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE)
  ))
  saveRDS(joint_fit, fit_file)
  fit_status("posterior_saved")
}
```

```{r fit-runtime}
fit_runtime <- tryCatch(as.data.frame(rstan::get_elapsed_time(joint_fit$fit)),
                        error = function(e) NULL)
if (!is.null(fit_runtime)) {
  fit_runtime$chain <- seq_len(nrow(fit_runtime))
  write_csv(fit_runtime, output_file("fit_runtime_by_chain.csv"))
}
```

## Expected-density predictions

Expected density includes zero inflation: \(E[n/A]=(1-zi)\mu/A\).
PEV predictions explicitly select the PEV cells; regional predictions explicitly
select Broward–Miami cells. Both use the same joint posterior. Survey/source
effects remain included and direction effects are set to zero, matching the
original conditional prediction convention. Zero direction is not an
arithmetic average of the north and south predicted densities.

```{r predictions-functions}
# Keep the original manuscript convention: survey effects included, direction
# effects zero. The region indicator is always rebuilt from an explicit argument.
source_effects <- ~ (1 + Type | dataset) + (1 | dataset:taxon:class)
density_effects <- if (params$regional_distributional_effects) {
  ~ (1 + Type | dataset) + (1 | dataset:taxon:class) + (0 + regional | cell)
} else source_effects
prediction_audit <- tibble(purpose = character(), region = character(), rows = integer(),
                           datasets = character(), area_m2 = numeric())

prediction_data <- function(prepared, newdata, region) {
  stopifnot(length(region) == 1L, region %in% c("PEV", "Broward-Miami"))
  d <- as.data.frame(newdata)
  d$region <- factor(rep(region, nrow(d)), levels = levels(model_data$region))
  d$regional <- as.integer(d$region == "Broward-Miami")
  k <- match(paste(d$taxon, d$class, d$Type),
             paste(prepared$grid$taxon, prepared$grid$class, prepared$grid$Type))
  stopifnot(!anyNA(k))
  d$cell <- factor(k, levels = prepared$grid$cell_id, labels = levels(model_data$cell))
  for (v in c("taxon", "class", "Type", "dataset")) {
    d[[v]] <- factor(d[[v]], levels = levels(model_data[[v]]))
  }
  # An observed placeholder is supplied only for brms data validation. Direction
  # effects are excluded from mu below, so its identity cannot affect density.
  reference_group <- as.character(model_data$direction_group[which(model_data$region == region)[1]])
  d$direction_group <- factor(rep(reference_group, nrow(d)), levels = levels(model_data$direction_group))
  d$transect_area_m2 <- 1
  stopifnot(!anyNA(d[c("taxon", "class", "Type", "dataset", "cell", "region")]),
            all(as.character(d$region) == region),
            all(d$regional == as.integer(region == "Broward-Miami")))
  d
}

expected_density_draws <- function(prepared, fit, newdata, region,
                                   purpose = "diagnostics_or_comparisons") {
  d <- prediction_data(prepared, newdata, region)
  # Retain source effects and, when fitted, regional zi/shape slopes.
  # Direction effects are excluded in both model variants.
  result <- posterior_epred(fit, newdata = d, re_formula = density_effects)
  prediction_audit <<- bind_rows(prediction_audit,
    tibble(purpose = purpose, region = region, rows = nrow(d),
           datasets = paste(sort(unique(as.character(d$dataset))), collapse = ";"), area_m2 = 1))
  result
}

summarize_density_draws <- function(draw_matrix, g) cbind(g, as.data.frame(t(apply(draw_matrix,
  2, function(x) c(mean = mean(x), median = median(x), lower = unname(quantile(x, 0.025)),
                  upper = unname(quantile(x, 0.975)), maximum = max(x),
                  largest_draw_share = max(x)/sum(x))))))
```

```{r prediction-draw-interface}
joint_epred_draws <- function(newdata, region = "PEV", ndraws = NULL) {
  # This interface feeds manuscript figures/tables only; regional comparisons
  # call expected_density_draws() separately with an explicit regional target.
  stopifnot(identical(region, "PEV"))
  prediction_matrix <- expected_density_draws(prepared, joint_fit, newdata, region,
                                             purpose = "manuscript")
  draw_ids <- seq_len(nrow(prediction_matrix))
  if (!is.null(ndraws) && ndraws < length(draw_ids)) {
    set.seed(params$seed)
    draw_ids <- sort(sample(draw_ids, ndraws))
    prediction_matrix <- prediction_matrix[draw_ids, , drop = FALSE]
  }
  draws_per_row <- nrow(prediction_matrix)
  tibble(newdata[rep(seq_len(nrow(newdata)), each = draws_per_row), , drop = FALSE]) %>%
    mutate(.row = rep(seq_len(nrow(newdata)), each = draws_per_row),
           .draw = rep(draw_ids, times = nrow(newdata)),
           .epred = as.vector(prediction_matrix))
}
```

## Habitat-area weights for the sensitivity comparison

The primary regional comparison and temporal trends give each modeled reef
habitat weight 1/4. The following area calculations are used only for the
own-area sensitivity results. That alternative weights each habitat by its
area divided by the region's total NRC + IR + MR + OR area, allowing habitat
composition as well as habitat-specific density to contribute to the regional
contrast. The primary equal-habitat comparison standardizes habitat composition
between regions and years; neither calculation averages survey sites.

PEV areas are the existing unrounded project/monitoring-area habitat totals
from Table S1 (Scenario 2, NMFS consideration areas and the rest of the
monitoring area). Broader Broward–Miami areas use the complete FDEP habitat
map's `Region = "Broward-Miami"`, outside the 1,200 m north/south PEV band.
Biscayne, Deerfield, Palm Beach and Martin map regions are excluded. The PEV
project footprint and the model's classification band are not identical
geometries. These area choices reproduce the reviewed own-area sensitivity
test; they do not change observation membership or habitat assignments.

Both area calculations pool Artificial with NRC and Aggregated Patch Reef
with OR, and exclude other habitat classes. The regional input contains all
1,868 Broward–Miami source polygons, rather than just those intersecting
survey sites. Within-class regional overlaps are dissolved; small areas with
conflicting reef-class labels are omitted from all regional classes. PEV
areas retain the existing Table S1 convention. Map boundaries and areas are
treated as fixed; mapping uncertainty is not propagated into the intervals.

```{r regional-habitat-area-weights}
area_habitats <- c("Nearshore Ridge Complex", "Inner Reef", "Middle Reef", "Outer Reef")
area_source <- "data/spatial/drm_regional_habitat/broward_miami_full_region.gpkg"
area_provenance <- read_json(
  "data/spatial/drm_regional_habitat/broward_miami_full_region_provenance.json",
  simplifyVector = TRUE)
stopifnot(identical(digest(file = area_source, algo = "sha256"), area_provenance$sha256))
regional_area_source <- st_read(area_source, quiet = TRUE) %>%
  st_zm(drop = TRUE) %>% st_transform(32617) %>% st_make_valid()
regional_area_source <- st_sf(st_drop_geometry(regional_area_source),
                             geometry = st_geometry(regional_area_source))
stopifnot(nrow(regional_area_source) == 1868L,
          all(regional_area_source$Region == "Broward-Miami"))

# Check that the complete map region covers every raw Broward–Miami DRM site.
area_site_audit <- regional_site_coordinates %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326) %>% st_transform(32617) %>%
  st_join(select(regional_area_source, map_region = Region)) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>% distinct(site, map_region)
stopifnot(n_distinct(area_site_audit$site) == 138L,
          !anyNA(area_site_audit$map_region), all(area_site_audit$map_region == "Broward-Miami"))
write_csv(area_site_audit, output_file("regional_habitat_area_site_audit.csv"))

regional_dissolved <- regional_area_source %>%
  mutate(Type = case_when(Type == "Artificial" ~ area_habitats[1],
                         Type == "Aggregated Patch Reef" ~ area_habitats[4], TRUE ~ Type)) %>%
  filter(Type %in% area_habitats) %>% group_by(Type) %>% summarize(.groups = "drop")
cross_class_intersections <- lapply(combn(seq_len(nrow(regional_dissolved)), 2,
  simplify = FALSE), function(pair) suppressWarnings(st_intersection(
    st_geometry(regional_dissolved[pair[1], ]), st_geometry(regional_dissolved[pair[2], ]))))
ambiguous_reef_area <- st_union(do.call(c, cross_class_intersections))
ambiguous_m2 <- sum(as.numeric(st_area(ambiguous_reef_area)))
regional_union_m2 <- sum(as.numeric(st_area(st_union(regional_dissolved))))
stopifnot(ambiguous_m2 / regional_union_m2 < 0.001)
regional_clean <- suppressWarnings(st_difference(regional_dissolved, ambiguous_reef_area))
stopifnot(abs(sum(as.numeric(st_area(regional_clean))) -
  sum(as.numeric(st_area(st_union(regional_clean))))) < 0.01)

area_bbox <- st_bbox(regional_clean)
pev_area_band <- st_as_sfc(st_bbox(c(xmin = area_bbox[["xmin"]] - 1,
  xmax = area_bbox[["xmax"]] + 1, ymin = geographic_rule$pev_ymin_m,
  ymax = geographic_rule$pev_ymax_m), crs = st_crs(regional_clean)))
regional_area_polygons <- suppressWarnings(st_difference(regional_clean, pev_area_band))
regional_habitat_weights <- bind_rows(
  area_summary %>% group_by(Type) %>% summarize(area_m2 = sum(total_area_m2), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(region = "PEV"),
  regional_area_polygons %>% mutate(area_m2 = as.numeric(st_area(geometry))) %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>% mutate(region = "Broward-Miami")
) %>% group_by(region) %>% mutate(weight = area_m2 / sum(area_m2)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  mutate(habitat = c("NRC", "IR", "MR", "OR")[match(Type, area_habitats)],
         area_km2 = area_m2 / 1e6) %>% arrange(region, match(Type, area_habitats))
stopifnot(nrow(regional_habitat_weights) == 8L, all(regional_habitat_weights$weight > 0),
  all(abs(tapply(regional_habitat_weights$weight, regional_habitat_weights$region, sum) - 1) < 1e-12))
write_csv(regional_habitat_weights, output_file("regional_habitat_area_weights.csv"))
write_csv(data.frame(ambiguous_map_area_m2 = ambiguous_m2,
  regional_source_union_m2 = regional_union_m2,
  ambiguous_fraction = ambiguous_m2 / regional_union_m2,
  treatment = "Omitted from every regional reef class; observations unchanged"),
  output_file("regional_habitat_area_overlap_audit.csv"))
st_write(regional_area_polygons, processed_file("regional_habitat_area_polygons.gpkg"),
         delete_dsn = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)

habitat_area_weights <- function(types, target_region) {
  w <- filter(regional_habitat_weights, region == target_region)
  answer <- w$weight[match(as.character(types), w$Type)]
  stopifnot(!anyNA(answer))
  answer
}
show_table(regional_habitat_weights %>% select(region, habitat, area_km2, weight), digits = 4)
```

## Sampling diagnostics and posterior predictive checks

Checks retain each observation's searched area, source, region and direction.
Expected densities are independently checked against native brms predictions.
PPCs check density, zero fraction, positive sites and maximum counts by
region/source/taxon/class/habitat. No posterior draws are trimmed by density.

```{r evaluation-functions}
distributional_diagnostics <- function(prepared, fit) {
  nd <- mutate(prepared$grid, dataset = "drm24")
  draw_shape <- dim(posterior::as_draws_array(fit))[1:2]
  rows <- list()
  for (region in c("PEV", "Broward-Miami")) {
    d <- prediction_data(prepared, nd, region)
    components <- list(
      log_mu = posterior_linpred(fit, newdata = d, re_formula = source_effects),
      zi_logit = posterior_linpred(fit, newdata = d, dpar = "zi", re_formula = NULL),
      log_shape = posterior_linpred(fit, newdata = d, dpar = "shape", re_formula = NULL))
    for (component in names(components)) {
      x <- components[[component]]
      colnames(x) <- paste0("cell", seq_len(ncol(x)))
      ar <- array(x, dim = c(draw_shape, ncol(x)), dimnames = list(NULL, NULL, colnames(x)))
      stats <- posterior::summarise_draws(posterior::as_draws_array(ar),
                 "mean", "mcse_mean", "rhat", "ess_bulk", "ess_tail")
      rows[[paste(region, component)]] <- bind_cols(prepared$grid, stats) %>%
        mutate(region = region, component = component)
    }
  }
  bind_rows(rows) %>% mutate(regional_full_survey_support = region == "PEV" | class == ">4cm" |
                               taxon %in% c("MCAV", "MEAN", "MUSS", "FAVI"))
}

summarize_joint_fit <- function(prepared, fit, output_dir) {
  draws <- posterior::as_draws_array(fit)
  parameters <- posterior::summarise_draws(draws)
  sampler <- rstan::get_sampler_params(fit$fit, inc_warmup = FALSE)
  diagnostics <- data.frame(
    max_rhat = max(parameters$rhat, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_bulk_ess = min(parameters$ess_bulk, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_tail_ess = min(parameters$ess_tail, na.rm = TRUE),
    divergences = sum(vapply(sampler, function(x) sum(x[, "divergent__"]), numeric(1))),
    treedepth_hits = sum(vapply(sampler, function(x) sum(x[, "treedepth__"] >= fit_settings$max_treedepth), numeric(1)))
  )
  diagnostics$pass <- with(diagnostics, max_rhat < 1.01 & min_bulk_ess > 400 &
                            min_tail_ess > 400 & divergences == 0 & treedepth_hits == 0)
  write_csv(arrange(parameters, desc(rhat)), file.path(output_dir, "parameter_diagnostics.csv"))
  write_csv(diagnostics, file.path(output_dir, "sampling_diagnostics.csv"))
  K <- nrow(prepared$grid)
  nd <- mutate(prepared$grid, dataset = "drm24")
  den <- cbind(expected_density_draws(prepared, fit, nd, "PEV"),
               expected_density_draws(prepared, fit, nd, "Broward-Miami"))
  grid <- bind_rows(mutate(nd, region = "PEV"), mutate(nd, region = "Broward-Miami"))
  density <- left_join(summarize_density_draws(den, grid),
    prepared$counts %>% filter(dataset == "drm24") %>%
      group_by(region, taxon, class, Type) %>%
      summarise(rows = n(), positive_rows = sum(n > 0), colonies = sum(n),
                searched_m2 = sum(transect_area_m2), .groups = "drop"),
    by = c("region", "taxon", "class", "Type"))
  write_csv(density, file.path(output_dir, "density_2024_all_cells.csv"))
  # Diagnose each habitat cell as well as the habitat-averaged estimates below.
  cell_labels <- with(grid, paste(taxon, class, Type, region, sep = "|"))
  cell_array <- array(den, dim = c(dim(draws)[1:2], ncol(den)),
                      dimnames = list(NULL, NULL, cell_labels))
  cell_diagnostics <- posterior::summarise_draws(posterior::as_draws_array(cell_array),
    "mean", "mcse_mean", "rhat", "ess_bulk", "ess_tail") %>%
    mutate(relative_mcse = mcse_mean / pmax(abs(mean), 1e-12)) %>%
    left_join(mutate(grid, variable = cell_labels), by = "variable") %>%
    mutate(regional_full_survey_support = region == "PEV" | class == ">4cm" |
             taxon %in% c("MCAV", "MEAN", "MUSS", "FAVI"))
  write_csv(cell_diagnostics, file.path(output_dir, "density_cell_diagnostics.csv"))

  # Split each chain into two consecutive blocks to expose unstable tail means.
  iterations <- dim(draws)[1]
  chain_blocks <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(dim(draws)[2]), function(chain) {
    bind_rows(lapply(split(seq_len(iterations), ceiling(seq_len(iterations) / ceiling(iterations/2))),
      function(i) {
        block <- den[(chain - 1L) * iterations + i, , drop = FALSE]
        data.frame(variable = cell_labels, chain = chain, first_iteration = min(i),
          last_iteration = max(i), mean = colMeans(block),
          median = apply(block, 2, median),
          largest_draw_share = apply(block, 2, max) / colSums(block))
      }))
  }))
  write_csv(chain_blocks, file.path(output_dir, "density_chain_block_stability.csv"))
  tail_review <- density %>%
    filter(region == "PEV" | class == ">4cm" | taxon %in% c("MCAV", "MEAN", "MUSS", "FAVI")) %>%
    mutate(mean_to_median = mean/median, maximum_to_upper_95 = maximum/upper) %>%
    arrange(desc(largest_draw_share))
  write_csv(tail_review, file.path(output_dir, "density_tail_review.csv"))
  average <- function(z, target_region) vapply(seq_len(nrow(prepared$tc)), function(i) {
    cells <- prepared$grid$tc_id == i
    rowMeans(z[, cells, drop = FALSE])
  }, numeric(nrow(z)))
  pev <- average(den[, seq_len(K)], "PEV")
  regional <- average(den[, K + seq_len(K)], "Broward-Miami")
  contrast <- mutate(summarize_density_draws(pev - regional, prepared$tc),
    probability_pev_gt_regional = colMeans(pev > regional),
    probability_pev_lt_regional = colMeans(pev < regional))
  eligible <- prepared$tc$class == ">4cm" | prepared$tc$taxon %in% c("MCAV", "FAVI", "MEAN", "MUSS")
  contrast$regional_full_survey_support <- eligible
  for (v in c("mean", "median", "lower", "upper", "maximum", "largest_draw_share",
              "probability_pev_gt_regional", "probability_pev_lt_regional")) contrast[[v]][!eligible] <- NA
  write_csv(contrast, file.path(output_dir, "habitat_averaged_2024_contrasts.csv"))
  z <- cbind(pev, regional, pev - regional)
  colnames(z) <- c(paste(prepared$tc$taxon, prepared$tc$class, "PEV", sep = ":"),
                   paste(prepared$tc$taxon, prepared$tc$class, "regional", sep = ":"),
                   paste(prepared$tc$taxon, prepared$tc$class, "difference", sep = ":"))
  ar <- array(z, dim = c(dim(draws)[1:2], ncol(z)), dimnames = list(NULL, NULL, colnames(z)))
  derived <- posterior::summarise_draws(posterior::as_draws_array(ar),
    "mean", "mcse_mean", "rhat", "ess_bulk", "ess_tail") %>%
    mutate(relative_mcse = mcse_mean/pmax(abs(mean), 1e-12))
  write_csv(derived, file.path(output_dir, "prediction_diagnostics.csv"))
  component_checks <- distributional_diagnostics(prepared, fit)
  write_csv(component_checks, file.path(output_dir, "distributional_prediction_diagnostics.csv"))

  # PPCs include each observed region, source, direction and actual searched area.
  d <- prepared$counts
  set.seed(20261028)
  take <- sort(sample(seq_len(nrow(posterior::as_draws_matrix(fit))), 250))
  yrep <- posterior_predict(fit, newdata = d, re_formula = NULL, draw_ids = take)
  stopifnot(all(is.finite(yrep)))
  # Verify the fitted count likelihood independently in R, including effort,
  # region, source, direction, zero inflation and negative-binomial shape.
  audit_draws <- take[round(seq(1, length(take), length.out = 10))]
  count_eta <- posterior_linpred(fit, newdata = d, re_formula = NULL, draw_ids = audit_draws)
  count_zi <- posterior_linpred(fit, newdata = d, dpar = "zi", re_formula = NULL, draw_ids = audit_draws)
  count_shape <- posterior_linpred(fit, newdata = d, dpar = "shape", re_formula = NULL,
                                   transform = TRUE, draw_ids = audit_draws)
  manual_log_lik <- matrix(dnbinom(rep(d$n, each = length(audit_draws)),
                                   mu = exp(count_eta), size = count_shape, log = TRUE),
                            nrow = length(audit_draws)) + plogis(-count_zi, log.p = TRUE)
  zero_columns <- d$n == 0
  a <- plogis(count_zi[, zero_columns, drop = FALSE], log.p = TRUE)
  b <- manual_log_lik[, zero_columns, drop = FALSE]
  m <- pmax(a, b)
  manual_log_lik[, zero_columns] <- m + log(exp(a - m) + exp(b - m))
  native_log_lik <- log_lik(fit, newdata = d, re_formula = NULL, draw_ids = audit_draws)
  likelihood_error <- max(abs(manual_log_lik - native_log_lik))
  write_csv(data.frame(maximum_absolute_log_likelihood_error = likelihood_error,
                       pass = likelihood_error < 1e-8), file.path(output_dir, "likelihood_validation.csv"))
  stopifnot(likelihood_error < 1e-8)
  rm(count_eta, count_zi, count_shape, manual_log_lik, native_log_lik, a, b, m)
  groups <- split(seq_len(nrow(d)), interaction(d$region, d$dataset, d$taxon, d$class, d$Type, drop = TRUE))
  ppc <- bind_rows(lapply(groups, function(ix) {
    observed <- c(density = mean(d$n[ix]/d$transect_area_m2[ix]),
                  zero_fraction = mean(d$n[ix] == 0), maximum = max(d$n[ix]),
                  positive_sites = sum(d$n[ix] > 0))
    predicted <- list(
      density = rowMeans(sweep(yrep[, ix, drop = FALSE], 2, d$transect_area_m2[ix], "/")),
      zero_fraction = rowMeans(yrep[, ix, drop = FALSE] == 0),
      maximum = apply(yrep[, ix, drop = FALSE], 1, max),
      positive_sites = rowSums(yrep[, ix, drop = FALSE] > 0))
    bind_rows(lapply(names(predicted), function(metric) {
      x <- predicted[[metric]]
      lo <- unname(quantile(x, 0.025)); hi <- unname(quantile(x, 0.975))
      data.frame(d[ix[1], c("region", "dataset", "taxon", "class", "Type")],
                 metric = metric, observed = observed[[metric]], predicted_median = median(x),
                 lower = lo, upper = hi, outside_95 = observed[[metric]] < lo | observed[[metric]] > hi)
    }))
  }))
  write_csv(ppc, file.path(output_dir, "posterior_predictive_checks.csv"))
  ppc_summary <- ppc %>% group_by(region, dataset, class, metric) %>%
    summarize(cells = n(), outside_95 = sum(outside_95), .groups = "drop")
  write_csv(ppc_summary, file.path(output_dir, "posterior_predictive_check_summary.csv"))

  # Independent checks against brms's full expected-value calculation.
  audit <- d[!duplicated(d[c("region", "taxon", "class", "Type")]), , drop = FALSE]
  audit$transect_area_m2 <- 1
  mu_full <- posterior_linpred(fit, newdata = audit, re_formula = NULL)
  mu_zero_direction <- posterior_linpred(fit, newdata = audit, re_formula = source_effects)
  zi <- posterior_linpred(fit, newdata = audit, dpar = "zi", re_formula = NULL)
  epred_full <- posterior_epred(fit, newdata = audit, re_formula = NULL)
  expected <- exp(mu_zero_direction + plogis(-zi, log.p = TRUE))
  independent <- epred_full * exp(mu_zero_direction - mu_full)
  native_conditional <- posterior_epred(fit, newdata = audit, re_formula = density_effects)
  error <- max(abs(expected - independent)/pmax(1, abs(independent)),
               abs(native_conditional - independent)/pmax(1, abs(independent)))
  # Changing an excluded direction identifier must not change predictions.
  validation <- data.frame(
    check = c("Conditional density matches brms expected value after removing direction",
              "PEV prediction data explicitly encode PEV and regional=0",
              "Regional prediction data explicitly encode Broward-Miami and regional=1"),
    pass = c(error < 1e-10,
             all(prediction_data(prepared, nd, "PEV")$regional == 0L),
             all(prediction_data(prepared, nd, "Broward-Miami")$regional == 1L)))
  stopifnot(all(validation$pass))
  write_csv(validation, file.path(output_dir, "prediction_validation.csv"))
  plot_data <- filter(ppc, dataset == "drm24", metric == "density")
  g <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(observed, predicted_median, color = region)) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "gray60") +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), alpha = 0.25, width = 0) +
    geom_point(size = 1) + facet_grid(class ~ Type, scales = "free") + theme_minimal() +
    labs(x = "Observed site-mean colonies/m²", y = "Replicated median and 95% interval",
         title = "2024 posterior predictive checks")
  ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "posterior_predictive_density.png"), g,
         width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 250, bg = "white")
  result <- list(diagnostic = diagnostics, density = density, contrast = contrast,
                 derived = derived, components = component_checks, ppc = ppc,
                 posterior_file = fit_file, hash = fit_hash)
  saveRDS(result, file.path(output_dir, "evaluation.rds"))
  result
}
```

```{r evaluate-joint-model}
joint_evaluation <- summarize_joint_fit(prepared, joint_fit, output_dir)
show_table(joint_evaluation$diagnostic)
show_table(head(joint_evaluation$derived[order(-joint_evaluation$derived$rhat), ], 15))
show_table(joint_evaluation$components %>% filter(regional_full_survey_support) %>%
  group_by(component, region) %>% summarize(max_rhat = max(rhat),
    min_bulk_ess = min(ess_bulk), min_tail_ess = min(ess_tail), .groups = "drop"), digits = 3)
knitr::include_graphics(output_file("posterior_predictive_density.png"))
show_table(joint_evaluation$ppc %>%
  filter(dataset == "drm24", taxon == "ACER", class == ">4cm") %>%
  select(region, Type, metric, observed, predicted_median, lower, upper, outside_95), digits = 4)
show_table(read_csv(output_file("density_tail_review.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 12) %>%
  mutate(largest_draw_percent = 100 * largest_draw_share) %>%
  select(taxon, class, Type, region, mean, median, upper, maximum, largest_draw_percent), digits = 4)
```

### Bayesian R-squared and original posterior predictive checks

These checks retain the original analysis framework. Bayesian R-squared uses
colony counts, as in the original `bayes_R2()` call. Posterior predictive
statistics use densities (counts divided by each observation's actual searched
area). Replications retain every observation's dataset, region and direction
and include all fitted random effects; they are not the direction-zero,
1 m² predictions used for manuscript density estimates.

The global checks compare mean, variance, zero proportion, skewness and a
chi-squared discrepancy. Grouped checks compare mean, standard deviation,
zero proportion and skewness within taxon–size-class–habitat combinations.
Both are reported for all observations and separately for PEV and Broward–Miami.
The existing finer checks by dataset and region remain above.

```{r original-framework-predictive-draws}
# Reuse the saved posterior: these calculations never fit a new model.
# R² uses all 4,000 draws. PPCs use 1,000 selected draws, as in the original.
stopifnot(requireNamespace("e1071", quietly = TRUE))
check_draw_count <- min(1000L, posterior::ndraws(joint_fit))
check_signature <- list(
  fit_hash = fit_hash, draws = check_draw_count, seed = 124L,
  version = "original_framework_v1", brms = as.character(packageVersion("brms"))
)
check_cache <- processed_file(paste0("original_framework_draws_",
                                     digest::digest(check_signature), ".rds"))
if (file.exists(check_cache)) {
  original_check_draws <- readRDS(check_cache)
  stopifnot(identical(original_check_draws$signature, check_signature))
} else {
  # Native brms R², using the fitted count response and all random effects.
  r2_draws <- as.numeric(bayes_R2(joint_fit, summary = FALSE, re_formula = NULL))
  set.seed(124)
  check_draw_ids <- sort(sample(seq_len(posterior::ndraws(joint_fit)), check_draw_count))
  replicated_counts <- posterior_predict(
    joint_fit, newdata = model_data, re_formula = NULL, draw_ids = check_draw_ids
  )
  expected_counts <- posterior_epred(
    joint_fit, newdata = model_data, re_formula = NULL, draw_ids = check_draw_ids
  )
  original_check_draws <- list(signature = check_signature, r2 = r2_draws,
    draw_ids = check_draw_ids, replicated_counts = replicated_counts,
    expected_counts = expected_counts)
  saveRDS(original_check_draws, check_cache)
}
stopifnot(identical(as.numeric(model_data$n), as.numeric(joint_fit$data$n)),
          identical(as.numeric(model_data$transect_area_m2),
                    as.numeric(joint_fit$data$transect_area_m2)),
          all(is.finite(original_check_draws$expected_counts)),
          all(original_check_draws$expected_counts > 0),
          all(is.finite(original_check_draws$replicated_counts)),
          ncol(original_check_draws$replicated_counts) == nrow(model_data))
observed_density <- model_data$n / model_data$transect_area_m2
replicated_density <- sweep(original_check_draws$replicated_counts, 2,
                             model_data$transect_area_m2, "/")
expected_density <- sweep(original_check_draws$expected_counts, 2,
                           model_data$transect_area_m2, "/")
check_scopes <- list(
  `All observations` = seq_len(nrow(model_data)),
  PEV = which(model_data$region == "PEV"),
  `Broward-Miami` = which(model_data$region == "Broward-Miami")
)
r2_summary <- data.frame(
  response_scale = "Colony counts", observations = nrow(model_data),
  posterior_draws = length(original_check_draws$r2),
  mean = mean(original_check_draws$r2), sd = sd(original_check_draws$r2),
  lower = unname(quantile(original_check_draws$r2, 0.025)),
  upper = unname(quantile(original_check_draws$r2, 0.975))
)
write_csv(r2_summary, output_file("bayesian_r2.csv"))
write_csv(data.frame(draw = seq_along(original_check_draws$r2),
                     r2 = original_check_draws$r2), output_file("bayesian_r2_draws.csv"))
show_table(r2_summary)
```

#### Global posterior predictive checks

For the chi-squared discrepancy, observed and replicated densities are compared
with the same expected densities **within each posterior draw**. This corrects
the original code, which used posterior-average expected densities for the
observed discrepancy but draw-specific expectations for replications. The
quantity is a predictive discrepancy, not a classical chi-squared test.

```{r original-global-posterior-checks}
global_check_draws <- bind_rows(lapply(names(check_scopes), function(scope) {
  ix <- check_scopes[[scope]]
  y <- observed_density[ix]
  yrep <- replicated_density[, ix, drop = FALSE]
  mu <- expected_density[, ix, drop = FALSE]
  observed <- c(mean = mean(y), variance = var(y), zero_prop = mean(y == 0),
                skewness = moments::skewness(y))
  replicated <- data.frame(
    draw = original_check_draws$draw_ids,
    mean = rowMeans(yrep), variance = apply(yrep, 1, var),
    zero_prop = rowMeans(yrep == 0),
    skewness = apply(yrep, 1, moments::skewness)
  )
  # Pair both discrepancies with the same posterior draw of mu.
  observed_chi <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(mu)), function(i)
    sum((y - mu[i, ])^2 / mu[i, ]), numeric(1))
  replicated$chi_squared <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(mu)), function(i)
    sum((yrep[i, ] - mu[i, ])^2 / mu[i, ]), numeric(1))
  replicated %>% pivot_longer(-draw, names_to = "statistic", values_to = "replicated") %>%
    mutate(scope = scope, observations = length(ix),
           observed = if_else(statistic == "chi_squared",
                              observed_chi[match(draw, original_check_draws$draw_ids)],
                              unname(observed[statistic])))
}))
global_checks <- global_check_draws %>%
  group_by(scope, observations, statistic) %>%
  summarize(observed_mean = mean(observed),
            replicated_mean = mean(replicated),
            replicated_lower = quantile(replicated, 0.025),
            replicated_upper = quantile(replicated, 0.975),
            posterior_predictive_probability = mean(replicated >= observed),
            predictive_draws = n(), .groups = "drop")
write_csv(global_checks, output_file("posterior_predictive_global.csv"))
write_csv(global_check_draws, output_file("posterior_predictive_global_draws.csv"))
show_table(global_checks %>% select(scope, statistic, posterior_predictive_probability))

plot_global_checks <- function(scope) {
  plots <- lapply(c("mean", "variance", "zero_prop", "skewness", "chi_squared"), function(stat) {
    d <- filter(global_check_draws, .data$scope == .env$scope, statistic == stat)
    stopifnot(nrow(d) == check_draw_count, all(d$scope == scope))
    ppp <- mean(d$replicated >= d$observed)
    # The chi discrepancy has a draw-specific observed value, so plot paired
    # differences with reference zero. Other panels retain the original style.
    chi <- stat == "chi_squared"
    d$plot_value <- if (chi) d$replicated - d$observed else d$replicated
    reference <- if (chi) 0 else d$observed[1]
    ggplot(d, aes(plot_value)) +
      geom_histogram(bins = 40, fill = "gray80", color = "white") +
      geom_vline(xintercept = reference, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
      labs(title = paste0(scope, ": ", stat, " (PPP = ", round(ppp, 3), ")"),
           x = if (chi) "Replicated minus observed discrepancy" else "Replicated statistic",
           y = "Posterior replications") + theme_minimal(base_size = 10)
  })
  cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = plots, ncol = 1)
}
ggsave(output_file("ppc_global_density.png"), plot_global_checks("All observations"),
       width = 8, height = 12, dpi = 180, bg = "white")
ggsave(output_file("ppc_global_density_by_region.png"),
       cowplot::plot_grid(plot_global_checks("PEV"), plot_global_checks("Broward-Miami"), ncol = 2),
       width = 14, height = 12, dpi = 180, bg = "white")
knitr::include_graphics(c(output_file("ppc_global_density.png"),
                          output_file("ppc_global_density_by_region.png")))
```

#### Grouped posterior predictive checks

These repeat the original four grouped statistics, including its separate
skewness conventions (`moments` globally and `e1071`, type 3, within groups).
All groups are saved, including all-zero groups. As in the original manuscript
summary, the main tally includes groups with at least one observed colony.
Undefined statistics are identified explicitly: skewness is undefined for a
constant sample and standard deviation is undefined for a single observation.
A PPP is left blank if its observed value or any replicated value is undefined,
rather than assigning a value to those cases or silently dropping replications.

```{r original-grouped-posterior-checks}
group_results <- unlist(lapply(names(check_scopes), function(scope) {
  ix <- check_scopes[[scope]]
  groups <- split(ix, interaction(model_data$taxon[ix], model_data$class[ix],
                                  model_data$Type[ix], drop = TRUE))
  lapply(groups, function(j) {
    y <- observed_density[j]
    yrep <- replicated_density[, j, drop = FALSE]
    id <- data.frame(scope = scope, taxon = as.character(model_data$taxon[j[1]]),
                     class = as.character(model_data$class[j[1]]),
                     Type = as.character(model_data$Type[j[1]]))
    observed <- bind_cols(id, data.frame(observations = length(j),
      positive_sites = sum(y > 0), mean = mean(y), sd = sd(y),
      zero_prop = mean(y == 0), skewness = e1071::skewness(y, type = 3))) %>%
      pivot_longer(c(mean, sd, zero_prop, skewness), names_to = "statistic", values_to = "observed")
    replicated <- bind_cols(id[rep(1, nrow(yrep)), ], data.frame(
      draw = original_check_draws$draw_ids, mean = rowMeans(yrep),
      sd = apply(yrep, 1, sd), zero_prop = rowMeans(yrep == 0),
      skewness = apply(yrep, 1, e1071::skewness, type = 3))) %>%
      pivot_longer(c(mean, sd, zero_prop, skewness), names_to = "statistic", values_to = "replicated")
    list(observed = observed, replicated = replicated)
  })
}), recursive = FALSE)
group_observed <- bind_rows(lapply(group_results, `[[`, "observed"))
group_check_draws <- bind_rows(lapply(group_results, `[[`, "replicated")) %>%
  left_join(group_observed, by = c("scope", "taxon", "class", "Type", "statistic"))
grouped_checks <- group_check_draws %>%
  group_by(scope, taxon, class, Type, statistic, observations, positive_sites) %>%
  summarize(observed = first(observed), predictive_draws = n(),
            defined_replicates = sum(is.finite(replicated)),
            replicated_median = if (any(is.finite(replicated))) median(replicated[is.finite(replicated)]) else NA_real_,
            replicated_lower = if (any(is.finite(replicated))) quantile(replicated[is.finite(replicated)], 0.025) else NA_real_,
            replicated_upper = if (any(is.finite(replicated))) quantile(replicated[is.finite(replicated)], 0.975) else NA_real_,
            posterior_predictive_probability = if (is.finite(first(observed)) && all(is.finite(replicated)))
              mean(replicated >= first(observed)) else NA_real_, .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(in_original_style_tally = positive_sites > 0,
         defined = is.finite(posterior_predictive_probability),
         extreme = if_else(defined, posterior_predictive_probability < 0.05 |
                                      posterior_predictive_probability > 0.95, NA))
grouped_check_summary <- grouped_checks %>% filter(in_original_style_tally) %>%
  group_by(scope) %>%
  summarize(statistics = n(), defined_statistics = sum(defined),
            undefined_statistics = sum(!defined), extreme_statistics = sum(extreme, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")
write_csv(grouped_checks, output_file("posterior_predictive_grouped.csv"), na = "")
write_csv(grouped_check_summary, output_file("posterior_predictive_grouped_summary.csv"))
write_csv(filter(grouped_checks, in_original_style_tally, extreme),
          output_file("posterior_predictive_grouped_extreme.csv"))
show_table(grouped_check_summary, digits = 0)
show_table(filter(grouped_checks, in_original_style_tally, extreme) %>%
             select(scope, taxon, class, Type, statistic, posterior_predictive_probability))

# Reproduce the four original pooled, faceted diagnostic plots and save them.
check_habitat_labels <- c("Nearshore Ridge Complex" = "NRC", "Inner Reef" = "IR",
                          "Middle Reef" = "MR", "Outer Reef" = "OR")
check_statistic_labels <- c(mean = "Mean density (colonies/m²)",
                            sd = "Density SD (colonies/m²)",
                            zero_prop = "Proportion zeros", skewness = "Skewness")
for (stat in c("mean", "sd", "zero_prop", "skewness")) {
  d <- group_check_draws %>%
    filter(scope == "All observations", statistic == stat, is.finite(replicated)) %>%
    mutate(Type = factor(Type, levels = names(check_habitat_labels)),
           taxon_class = paste(taxon, class))
  observed <- group_observed %>%
    filter(scope == "All observations", statistic == stat, is.finite(observed)) %>%
    mutate(Type = factor(Type, levels = names(check_habitat_labels)),
           taxon_class = paste(taxon, class))
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(Type, replicated)) +
    tidybayes::stat_halfeye(fill = "orange", alpha = 0.6, .width = c(0.5, 0.95),
                           normalize = "panels") +
    geom_point(data = observed, aes(y = observed), color = "red", size = 1) +
    facet_wrap(~ taxon_class, scales = "free_y", ncol = 5) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = check_habitat_labels, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(x = "Habitat", y = check_statistic_labels[[stat]],
         title = paste("Observed and replicated density summaries:", stat),
         caption = "All regions and surveys pooled. Orange: replications; red: observed. Skewness is undefined for constant samples.") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 9) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  ggsave(output_file(paste0("ppc_grouped_", stat, ".png")), p,
         width = 14, height = 14, dpi = 180, bg = "white")
}
knitr::include_graphics(vapply(c("mean", "sd", "zero_prop", "skewness"),
  function(stat) output_file(paste0("ppc_grouped_", stat, ".png")), character(1)))
```

#### Fit-check definitions and validation

PPP is the fraction of replications whose statistic is at least as large as
its observed counterpart. The diagnostic flag repeats the original thresholds
PPP <0.05 or >0.95; it is not a significance test or a multiplicity-adjusted
p-value. The grouped tally reports the number of defined statistics explicitly.
A discrete statistic can have a PPP of one because of ties (for example, when
the observed zero proportion is zero); inspect the predictive distribution
rather than treating the flag alone as evidence of poor fit.
A successful predictive check does not establish sampler convergence.

```{r original-framework-check-validation}
# Independently verify native count-scale R² on the selected posterior draws.
check_r2 <- vapply(seq_len(check_draw_count), function(i) {
  mu <- original_check_draws$expected_counts[i, ]
  var(mu) / (var(mu) + var(model_data$n - mu))
}, numeric(1))
r2_error <- max(abs(check_r2 - original_check_draws$r2[original_check_draws$draw_ids]))
# The chi-squared PPP must use paired differences, not the posterior mean mu.
chi_checks <- global_check_draws %>% filter(statistic == "chi_squared") %>%
  group_by(scope) %>% summarize(ppp = mean(replicated - observed >= 0), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(filter(global_checks, statistic == "chi_squared"), by = "scope")
check_validation <- data.frame(
  check = c("Native count-scale R-squared matches independently calculated residual-variance R-squared",
            "Observed and replicated chi-squared discrepancies are paired by posterior draw",
            "Global probabilities lie in [0,1] and use all selected replications",
            "Regional observation subsets partition the fitted data",
            "Undefined grouped statistics are not assigned diagnostic probabilities",
            "All scientific posterior draws are retained"),
  pass = c(r2_error < 1e-10,
           max(abs(chi_checks$ppp - chi_checks$posterior_predictive_probability)) < 1e-12,
           all(is.finite(global_checks$posterior_predictive_probability) &
                 global_checks$posterior_predictive_probability >= 0 &
                 global_checks$posterior_predictive_probability <= 1 &
                 global_checks$predictive_draws == check_draw_count),
           identical(sort(c(check_scopes$PEV, check_scopes$`Broward-Miami`)),
                     check_scopes$`All observations`),
           all(is.na(grouped_checks$posterior_predictive_probability[!grouped_checks$defined])),
           length(original_check_draws$r2) == posterior::ndraws(joint_fit))
)
write_csv(check_validation, output_file("original_framework_check_validation.csv"))
stopifnot(all(check_validation$pass))
write_csv(data.frame(
  setting = c("fit_hash", "r2_response_scale", "r2_posterior_draws", "ppc_response_scale", "ppc_draws",
              "ppc_random_effects", "global_skewness", "grouped_skewness", "chi_squared",
              "grouped_tally", "undefined_statistics"),
  value = c(fit_hash, "Colony counts", length(original_check_draws$r2), "Colonies/m2", check_draw_count,
            "All fitted effects, at each observation's actual region, dataset, direction and searched area",
            "moments::skewness", "e1071::skewness(type=3)",
            "Sum((density-expected_density)^2/expected_density), paired by posterior draw",
            "Observed-positive groups; flag PPP <0.05 or >0.95",
            "PPP left blank if observed or any replicated statistic is undefined")
), output_file("original_framework_check_method.csv"))
show_table(check_validation)
# Keep the compact summaries; release large predictive matrices before figures.
rm(original_check_draws, replicated_density, expected_density, group_results,
   group_check_draws, group_observed, global_check_draws)
```

### Chain energy and mixing checks

Energy exploration and trace plots supplement R-hat and effective sample size.
An E-BFMI below 0.3 is a flag for review, rather than evidence that a larger
iteration count alone will solve the problem. These diagnostics follow
[Stan's guidance](https://mc-stan.org/learn-stan/diagnostics-warnings.html).

```{r sampler-health-checks}
sampler_health_draws <- rstan::get_sampler_params(joint_fit$fit, inc_warmup = FALSE)
sampler_health <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(sampler_health_draws), function(chain) {
  x <- sampler_health_draws[[chain]]
  data.frame(chain = chain, sampling_iterations = nrow(x),
    ebfmi = mean(diff(x[, "energy__"])^2) / var(x[, "energy__"]),
    mean_acceptance = mean(x[, "accept_stat__"]),
    mean_leapfrog_steps = mean(x[, "n_leapfrog__"]),
    divergences = sum(x[, "divergent__"]),
    treedepth_hits = sum(x[, "treedepth__"] >= max_treedepth))
}))
write_csv(sampler_health, output_file("sampler_health_by_chain.csv"))
show_table(sampler_health, digits = 3)

# Show the five slowest-mixing parameters and the joint log posterior.
trace_parameters <- read_csv(output_file("parameter_diagnostics.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(variable != "lp__") %>% slice_head(n = 5) %>% pull(variable)
trace_parameters <- c(trace_parameters, "lp__")
trace_array <- posterior::as_draws_array(joint_fit)[, , trace_parameters, drop = FALSE]
trace_data <- as_tibble(posterior::as_draws_df(trace_array)) %>%
  select(.chain, .iteration, all_of(trace_parameters)) %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(trace_parameters), names_to = "parameter", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(parameter = factor(parameter, levels = trace_parameters), chain = factor(.chain))
trace_plot <- ggplot(trace_data, aes(.iteration, value, color = chain)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = .25, alpha = .75) +
  facet_wrap(~parameter, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) + theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Post-warmup iteration", y = NULL, color = "Chain",
       title = "Post-warmup traces for the slowest-mixing parameters")
ggsave(output_file("sampler_trace_review.png"), trace_plot,
       width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 180, bg = "white")
knitr::include_graphics(output_file("sampler_trace_review.png"))
```

```{r diagnostic-status, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
}
```
